name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix (game global) + battle_ domain (matches all sibling summon-anim arrays in anisummn.c and the only accessor fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_e_16slot) + summon_anim_variant_e_16slot descriptor (mirrors the function name and variant_a/b/d siblings) + frame_counter_array reflects datatype (int array) and semantics. '_e' (variant E) and '16slot' (16 sprite slots) are domain semantics, not Ghidra address residue; no hex suffix matching its own address.
purpose: Per-slot frame counter for the variant-E 16-slot summon-spell animation; one signed int32 per sprite slot, driving each slot's blit/SFX/advance during TICK frames.
logic_summary: 16 signed int32 entries indexed [0..15]. INIT (state_code 0) seeds frame_counter[i] = -2*i (0,-2,..,-30), giving a staggered start. On each TICK frame (state_code 2/5), for every slot i: if 0<=frame<8 blit sprite (frame + per_slot_sprite_base[i]); fire one-shot SFX at frame==0 and frame==4; then frame_counter[i]++ and set done_flag when a slot reaches 4. Negative values (pre-roll) are skipped by the signed 0<=frame<8 gate until that slot ramps up. Sole accessor: fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_e_16slot (init writer at 0x274E8, increment at 0x275A9, reads/tests at 0x2753E/0x27547/0x27571/0x2758D/0x275B0).
element_semantics: Each element = the current frame counter for one of 16 sprite slots. Signed: starts negative (staggered -2*i pre-roll), counts up by 1 per tick; while in [0,8) the slot is visible (blits frame + per-slot sprite-id base); frame 0 and 4 trigger SFX; reaching 4 marks the animation done for the dispatch loop.
notes: Mutable runtime BSS scratch in .object2 (64-byte read all 0x00). is_const=false: game writes it (INIT store -2*i and per-tick INC). datatype int[16] confirmed via Ghidra DataAt (DATATYPE=int[16], DATALEN=64) and disasm (EBX*0x4 stride, CMP EBX,0x10, signed JL).
